option_relations.rationale: Ocular Compartment Syndrome can be a subtype of Ocular Ischemic Syndrome due to the shared ischemic nature of the conditions.
Orbital Compartment Syndrome can be a broader class containing Ocular Ischemic Syndrome, as the orbital compartment includes the ocular compartment.
Saturday night retinopathy with orbital compression syndrome may be related to Central Retinal Artery Occlusion due to the potential for retinal ischemia.
Orbital compartment syndrome secondary to rhabdomyolysis can be an etiology of Ocular Ischemic Syndrome, as rhabdomyolysis can lead to compartment syndrome, which can cause ocular ischemia.
